capabilities: Create multiple calendar views, each with several note sources
Open or create the note for a day by clicking its indicator
Configure note path templates with moment-style date formats
Export and import settings as JSON backups
disambiguation: Not a collaboration or co-editing tool; it only displays notes from multiple folders together on one calendar.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; README includes a personal motivation story and development installation instructions.
intentEvidence: Instead of being limited to a single daily note location, you can define multiple note sources
motivation: The author keeps personal daily notes and AI-generated notes in separate folders and wanted to see both timelines side by side without blurring which notes came from whom.
problem: Obsidian's calendar and daily notes tooling assumes a single daily note location, so notes kept in several folders cannot be compared on one calendar.
summary: Calendar plugin that shows multiple note folders as color-coded sources on customizable calendar views for daily and journal notes.
